name: overhead_condenser
description: Drum overheads — condenser mic (e.g. U87, small diaphragm)
notes: Condensers capture high-frequency detail well but can be harsh above 8 kHz — roll off the top rather than boosting. HP at 100-120 Hz removes kick and floor tom bleed (let close mics handle the low end). Cut 4-6 kHz to tame harsh cymbal sizzle. Do NOT boost high shelf on condensers — roll off instead.
